selectedOriginals.caption: The keep of Nagoya Castle & the Honmaru Palace.
selectedOriginals.inspection: Accepted2019 original inspected: white main tiers, green copper roofs, paired gold ridge ornaments; smaller gray-roof keep and out-of-scope Palace distinguish physical components.

selectedOriginals.caption: Nagoya Castle
selectedOriginals.inspection: Accepted2011 original inspected: main five staggered eaves, triangular/curved dark gables, fan-curved stone base and corner quoins, low windows and rain pipes. Dry moat ground is distinct from upper courtyard.

additionalInspected.caption: Nagoya Castle aerial panorama
additionalInspected.inspection: Aerial panorama inspected: separate main/small keeps and lower connection; broad Honmaru Palace and entire enclosure are outside this asset. Native ground anchors, not roof parallax, govern plan.

additionalInspected.caption: 大天守と小天守
additionalInspected.inspection: Main and small keeps inspected together: green curved main roofs and dark ornamental gables, gray small-keep tile roofs, large distinct stone bases; modern white attached east access tower visible. Palace in foreground excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Nagoya Castle
additionalInspected.inspection: Connection original inspected: stone retaining bridge with exposed white parapet and gray tile coping between main and small keeps. No invented roofed connector or ground-through gateway.

additionalInspected.caption: The crow which approaches the golden shachihoko on Nagoya castle
additionalInspected.inspection: Gold shachi original inspected: upright tail, curved scaled fish body, open creature mouth and fin forms. Simplified original sculptural geometry, no copied historic crest.
